title: Fox Travels to Peru for Keiko Fujimori's Presidential Inauguration
detail: Vicente Fox travels to Lima to attend the July 28, 2026 inauguration of Keiko Fujimori as Peru's president for the 2026–2031 term — the first woman elected to Peru's presidency — despite lacking any official representation role for the Mexican government at the ceremony. Fox frames his attendance as promoting 'justice, democracy, freedom, market economy, human rights and the rule of law,' continuing a pattern of aligning himself with conservative Latin American governments while publicly opposing leftist administrations in the region, including Mexico's own Morena government.

media.caption: Fox confirms his attendance at Keiko Fujimori's presidential inauguration in Lima, Peru
